name: pages

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pages-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  studio:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - id: command
        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
        with:
          path: target/release/verdant_studio
          key: verdant-studio-${{ hashFiles('certified/**') }}
      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: npm-prism-code-0.11.1
      - if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
        with:
          path: target/lexlean
          key: lexlean-0.4.3
      - name: replay the certified bundle, then build its command (only when certified/ changed)
        if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -x target/lexlean/bin/lexlean || cargo install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean
          target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified
          cargo build --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target
      - name: check, build and publish through the API
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          target/release/verdant_studio check
          target/release/verdant_studio build
          target/release/verdant_studio publish
          if ! git diff --quiet; then echo "::error::publish changed $(git diff --name-only | tr '\n' ' '): run every operation through operate, which ends with check, build and publish"; exit 1; fi
      - name: accept only pull requests made through the API (last, so every seal step reports first)
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          app='afflom-verdant-studio[bot]'
          if [ "$AUTHOR" != "$app" ]; then
            echo "::error title=provenance::$AUTHOR opened this pull request, not $app through operate. Every seal step above passed; only the provenance gate refuses it."
            exit 1
          fi
          others=$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR}/commits" --paginate --jq ".[] | select(.author.login != \"$app\") | .sha")
          if [ -n "$others" ]; then
            echo "::error::these commits were not made by $app: $others"
            exit 1
          fi
      - if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@56afc609e74202658d3ffba0e8f6dda462b719fa # v3.0.1
        with:
          path: app/.prism/site

  pages:
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    needs: studio
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4.0.5

name: operate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['model/bindings/**', 'model/authorities.toml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      args:
        description: 'The operation and its arguments, e.g. "stage-bindings target/input/bindings.jsonl", or "advance" to run every operation that next derives'
        required: true
        default: 'advance'
        type: string
      input:
        description: 'Optional content, written to target/input/<input_name> before the operation runs'
        required: false
        type: string
      input_name:
        description: 'File name for input'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'input'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: operate
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  operate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - id: app
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@5d869da34e18e7287c1daad50e0b8ea0f506ce69 # v1.11.0
        with:
          app-id: ${{ vars.VERDANT_STUDIO_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.VERDANT_STUDIO_APP_KEY }}

        with:
          token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - if: inputs.args == 'propose-command'
        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
        with:
          path: ~/.elan
          key: lean-4.32.2-elan-4.1.2
      - if: inputs.args == 'propose-command'
        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
        with:
          path: target/lexlean
          key: lexlean-0.4.3
      - name: apply a change to the API's own sources, then export it again with Lean (propose-command only)
        if: inputs.args == 'propose-command'
        env:
          INPUT: ${{ inputs.input }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p target/input
          cat > target/input/change.patch <<< "$INPUT"
          outside=$(git apply --numstat target/input/change.patch | cut -f3 | grep -v -e '^studio/src/' -e '^README.md$' || true)
          if [ -n "$outside" ]; then echo "::error::propose-command changes only studio/src and README.md, not: $outside"; exit 1; fi
          git apply target/input/change.patch
          if [ ! -x "$HOME/.elan/bin/elan" ]; then
            curl -sSfL -o target/elan.tgz https://github.com/leanprover/elan/releases/download/v4.1.2/elan-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            echo "f81c2e48c1588d4612cd2c8851947898a45ac8d72748a07dff3a5694f1cf589b  target/elan.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
            tar -xzf target/elan.tgz -C target
            target/elan-init -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.32.2
          fi
          export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"
          test -d "$HOME/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.32.2" || elan toolchain install leanprover/lean4:v4.32.2
          test -x target/lexlean/bin/lexlean || cargo install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean
          ll="$PWD/target/lexlean/bin/lexlean"
          if ! (cd studio && "$ll" lock && "$ll" check && "$ll" production build --request production-request.json) > target/export.log 2>&1; then
            grep -m 20 'error' target/export.log | sed 's/^/::error::/'
            exit 1
          fi
          rm -rf certified
          cp -r studio/.lexlean/production/*/ certified
          rm -f certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.lock
          { echo "proposed a change to the API's sources, exported again as $(basename studio/.lexlean/production/*/)"; git diff --stat -- studio/src README.md; } > target/operation.txt
      - id: command
        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
        with:
          path: target/release/verdant_studio
          key: verdant-studio-${{ hashFiles('certified/**') }}
      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: npm-prism-code-0.11.1
      - if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3
        with:
          path: target/lexlean
          key: lexlean-0.4.3
      - name: replay the certified bundle, then build its command (only when certified/ changed)
        if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -x target/lexlean/bin/lexlean || cargo install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean
          target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified
          cargo build --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target
      - name: run the operation, then check, build and publish through the API, as the studio check does
        env:
          ARGS: ${{ inputs.args || 'advance' }}
          INPUT: ${{ inputs.input }}
          INPUT_NAME: ${{ inputs.input_name }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail -f
          if [ "$ARGS" = advance ] && [ "$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=open&per_page=100" --jq '[.[] | select(.title == "verdant_studio advance")] | length')" != 0 ]; then
            echo "::notice::an advance pull request is open; its merge changes model/authorities.toml, which runs advance again"
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ -n "$INPUT" ] && [ "$ARGS" != propose-command ]; then
            case "$INPUT_NAME" in */*|.*|'') echo "input_name must be a plain file name" >&2; exit 1;; esac
            mkdir -p target/input; cat > "target/input/$INPUT_NAME" <<< "$INPUT"
          fi
          if [ "$ARGS" = propose-command ]; then
            cat target/operation.txt
          elif [ "$ARGS" = advance ]; then
            : > target/operation.txt
            last=''
            skipped=''
            while op=$(target/release/verdant_studio next $skipped) && [ -n "$op" ]; do
              if [ "$op" = "$last" ]; then echo "::error::$op did not settle"; exit 1; fi
              if target/release/verdant_studio $op | tee -a target/operation.txt; then
                last=$op
              else
                binding=${op#ingest-authority }
                echo "::warning::$op was refused; the other bindings continue"
                echo "refused: $op" >> target/operation.txt
                git clean -fdq -- "authorities/$(basename "$binding" .json)"
                skipped="$skipped $binding"
              fi
            done
          else
            target/release/verdant_studio $ARGS | tee target/operation.txt
          fi
          target/release/verdant_studio check
          target/release/verdant_studio build
          target/release/verdant_studio publish
      - name: open a pull request as the Verdant Studio app
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
          SLUG: ${{ steps.app.outputs.app-slug }}
          ARGS: ${{ inputs.args || 'advance' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "no change"; exit 0; fi
          id=$(gh api "users/${SLUG}[bot]" --jq .id)
          git -c user.name="${SLUG}[bot]" -c user.email="${id}+${SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" commit -q -F - <<MSG
          verdant_studio $ARGS

          $(cat target/operation.txt)
          MSG
          branch="studio/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${branch}"
          gh pr create --head "$branch" --base main --title "verdant_studio $ARGS" --body-file target/operation.txt
          gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/rules/branches/main" > target/rules.json
          if [ "$ARGS" = propose-command ]; then
            echo "::notice::a change to the API itself waits for the owner's review"
          elif [ "$(target/release/verdant_studio merge-gate target/rules.json)" = merge ]; then
            gh pr merge "$branch" --auto --squash --delete-branch
          else
            echo "::notice::main does not require the studio check, so this pull request waits for the owner's merge"
          fi
